m: दुकूल m. a kind of plant, Hariv. 12680
दुकूल n. very fine cloth or raiment made of the inner bark of this plant, MBh.; Hariv.; Suśr.; Kāv. &c. (different from क्षौम, MBh. xiii, 7175, opp. to वल्कल, Bhartṛ. iii, 54).
a: दुकूलं — Woven silk, a silk-garment, a very fine garment in general; श्यामलमृदुलकलेवरमंडनमधिगतगौरदुकूलं Gīt. 11; Ku. 5. 67, 78; Bk. 3. 34, 10. 1; R. 17. 25.

k.v: पत्रोर्णं धौतकौशेयं बहुमूल्यं महाधनम्. क्षौमं दुकूलं स्याद्द्वे तु निवीतं प्रावृतं त्रिषु॥

m: दुकूल—पट्ट m. a head-band of fine cloth, Hariv. 7041.
दुकूल—वत् mfn. wearing a garment of fine cloth, Ragh. xvii, 25.
